string.text: Complete NES cartridge: modes A-N, one or two players and Construction. Progress is stored separately from Stalker saves.
G/N: 118 numbered stages; other modes: 50. Maps repeat.
Return to the Tank menu? The battle will be reset. Completed-level history is kept. Stalker saves are unchanged.

P1: WASD + Space
P2: arrows + Enter
Hold fire to repeat
Autofire: player 1

Defend headquarters, destroy tanks and collect bonuses. This is the complete Tank 1990 NES cartridge.

Menus: W/A or up/left previous, S/D or down/right next, Space confirms. Choose A-N, 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS / CONSTRUCTION and stage. G/N allow 118 numbered stages; other modes allow 50. Maps repeat.

Solo: WASD or arrows move, Space fires. 2 PLAYERS: player 1 WASD/Space, player 2 arrows/Enter. Hold either fire key to repeat. Autofire shoots for player 1 without Space, only in battle. Shift/Ctrl are not needed. Menu arrows always navigate; Enter is not used in menus. Construction uses movement and Space to cycle/place blocks; Done returns to the menu.

Progress lists the current mode's numbered stages: completed green, others gray. Only victories count; repeats, losses, demos and manual selection do not add victories. History starts with victory tracking and survives F9/restarts. Earlier wins cannot be inferred reliably from a battle snapshot.

Esc saves/exits to the games list; returning resumes. Main menu / F2 confirms a battle/autofire reset without erasing victories. F6 saves manually; autosave every ~20 seconds and on PDA close/exit. F9 never rewinds. A crash can lose up to 20 seconds. Volume -/+ below Sound: 0-100%, steps of 10%, default 50%; saved separately and multiplied by Stalker's effects volume.
